sloka: अवकीर्णम् लता वृक्षैः ददृशुः ते महा बिलम् ।तत्र क्रौन्चाः च हंसाः च सारसाः च अपि निष्क्रमन् ॥४-५०-९॥
transliteration: avakīrṇam latā vṛkṣaiḥ dadṛśuḥ te mahā bilam ।tatra krauncāḥ ca haṁsāḥ ca sārasāḥ ca api niṣkraman ॥4-50-9॥

translations.english: Just then, the kraunchas, swans, geese and chakravaka drenched in water with their limbs reddened with the pollen of lotuses were fluttering out (of the cave).
